mobileBrowser.navigationOverflowPolicy: Horizontal overflow exists only inside the intentional scrollable primary-nav container; page-level overflow is zero.

defectsFoundAndClosed.observed: 228px desktop and 428px mobile page-level horizontal overflow
defectsFoundAndClosed.rootCause: Intrinsic sizing of .diNewsGrid tracks allowed .diNewsCard content to expand beyond the viewport.
defectsFoundAndClosed.resolution: Use minmax(0,...) grid tracks plus min-width:0/max-width:100% on the news grid/cards; no overflow hiding.

defectsFoundAndClosed.observed: Automatic /favicon.ico request produced browser console noise in isolated QA.
defectsFoundAndClosed.resolution: Neutral data-URI favicon prevents a missing-resource request without inventing a branded icon.

rollback: Revert the UX v1 branch commits; canonical source/state data is unaffected.
integrationRule: Draft only. Reconcile with current main and rerun QA immediately before any approved merge.
